pre_condition: order_index is a mapping from FQN strings to non-negative integer positions, and fqn is a string.
post_condition: Returns a 2-tuple (position, fqn_str) where position is order_index[fqn] if fqn is a key in order_index, otherwise position is the total number of entries in order_index. The returned tuple produces a total order under lexicographic tuple comparison: entries with an explicit position in order_index sort before entries without one, and entries that share the same position sort lexicographically by their FQN string.
